My research spans artificial intelligence, deep learning, affective computing, and healthcare informatics. I study emotion detection and cognitive appraisal in text, and I focus on how AI systems interpret human emotions in real-world healthcare and human-centered contexts. I also work on explainable AI and dataset engineering, particularly developing structured emotion annotations and transparent evaluation methods. {{< ai blank-just-to-add-ai-dependency-to-this-page >}}

```{=html}
<script>
  // Add the number of entries in each section to the contents list
  // (and the Research sidebar on pages that have it), e.g. "Journal Articles (7)". Counts come from the listings,
  // so they update automatically when a paper is added.
  // Match TOC links by data-scroll-target: on the live site Quarto rewrites
  // their href to the full URL (https://.../research/#books) before this runs.
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const n = id => document.querySelectorAll(`#listing-${id} li.project`).length;
    const counts = {
      "books": document.querySelectorAll("#books .imgcolumn").length,
      "journal-articles": n("published-articles") + n("preprint-articles"),
      "published": n("published-articles"),
      "preprints": n("preprint-articles"),
      "conference-proceedings": n("conferences"),
      "book-chapters": n("book-chapters"),
    };
    for (const [anchor, count] of Object.entries(counts)) {
      if (!count) continue;
      const links = document.querySelectorAll(
        `#TOC a[data-scroll-target="#${anchor}"], #quarto-sidebar a[href$="#${anchor}"]`);
      links.forEach(a => {
        if (a.querySelector(".toc-count")) return;
        const target = a.querySelector(".menu-text") || a;
        target.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", ` <span class="toc-count">(${count})</span>`);
      });
    }
  });
</script>
```
